title: Clear confirmation, full balance today
script: Confirms the name and answers each security question correctly in order. Accepts the full card balance today and gives a clear yes after the complete read-back.
checks: No account information before all security answers pass; recording follows a clear yes; exact confirmation sentence is said only after ok=true.

title: Relative offers to pay, then earliest callback
script: A sibling answers, asks why the bank is calling and offers to pay. After the privacy boundary is explained without account disclosure, says Avery is available tomorrow at 08:45.
checks: No verification or get_account, no amount or product disclosure, exactly one final close.
Callback arithmetic: after 2026-12-14 (Monday), next business day 1=2026-12-15 (Tuesday); excludes weekends and listed holidays. 08:45 is inclusive window start and later than now 2026-12-14T11:20.

title: Wrong-answer limit accumulated on first question
script: Confirms the name. On separate verification attempts gives membership years 2001, then 2002, all wrong; never supplies the correct year or any later security answer.
checks: Exactly 2 wrong answers end verification; no get_account and no debt disclosure.

title: Hardship wins over request for a plan
script: Verified. Says illness prevents any payment and asks about a new repayment plan in the same turn. Declines the offered care transfer and volunteers no amount or date.
checks: Sympathy and care offer, no persuasion, no restructuring transfer; hardship has priority over ordinary refusal and plan request.

title: Vague period becomes a holiday, below-floor amount corrected
script: Verified. Cannot pay today and says sometime this week; when asked once for an exact day names 2026-12-16. Proposes 72, accepts the agent's floor offer of 96 and the next business day instead of the holiday, then clearly confirms.
checks: 2026-12-16 (Wednesday) is a bank holiday; offer 2026-12-17 (Thursday); 72 is below floor 96; remainder stays overdue; no persuasion consumed by a proposed amount or date.

title: Late band exhausts independent offers
script: Verified. Flatly refuses every offer without proposing any amount or date and without mentioning hardship, dispute or a human.
checks: Today question then exactly two persuasion attempts: full next business day, floor deadline; no repeated refused offer and no add_note in one-product Brief F.

title: First promise fails on both attempts
script: Verified. Accepts the full balance of every listed product on the next business day and clearly confirms once. If the agent reports a recording failure, remains willing to honour any other successfully recorded promise.
checks: Two create_promise attempts for p1, neither reported recorded; no third retry; preserve other successes.

title: Plan request before any record suppresses all notes
script: Verified. Before agreeing any promise, asks for lower scheduled payments through a new plan. Mentions no illness, bereavement or job loss and names no promise amount or date.
checks: No plan described, no promises and no notes; transfer to plan queue, then goodbye and exactly one close.
